title: Built in 1928, this $5.8M Dallas castle is now going to auction
summary_full: The Château des Grotteaux mansion is set for auction after nearly a year on the market, with bids starting at around two million dollars—significantly lower than its original asking price. This enchanting Dallas property features modern updates while maintaining its fairy-tale charm. The auction will conclude on September twenty-ninth, targeting buyers who cherish distinctiveness over mere historical value.
